tasks.label: stop MyApi on 5195
args: $pids = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5195 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.State -eq 'Listen' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; if ($pids) { $pids | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Output 'Stopped process(es) on port 5195.' } else { Write-Output 'No process on port 5195.' }
